## Organizing a growing portfolio

A Quarto listing collects pages and displays their metadata in one place. Rather than adding every project card by hand, I can add another QMD file to the projects folder and render the website again.

The examples below introduce areas of my learning. They are short summaries, rather than full analysis reports.

::: {#portfolio-projects}
:::

## How this page works

```yaml
listing:
  contents: projects
  type: grid
  fields: [title, description, categories]
  categories: true
  filter-ui: true
  sort: title
```

Each project provides a title, description, and categories in its YAML header. The listing reads those fields and creates the cards. Category controls help visitors browse by topic; the filter helps them find a specific entry.

## How I would use listings

For my portfolio, I could organize marketing analytics, AI research, and creative projects in one place. This would help an employer explore work that matches the role they are hiring for.
